A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, beside the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 7 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-deathstardetentionblockcontrolroom-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star: Detention Block Control Room (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text changes: “Drain” becomes “drain”. This is a full card image with the printed art; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right, beside the game-text box.

The previous slip and the same area of this image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
